description: Unofficial 3DOS-style menu for the SummerCart64 on the Analogue 3D
readme_excerpt: # SC64 A3D Library Menu A 3DOS-style menu for the **SummerCart64**, designed for the **Analogue 3D**. Library screen on an Analogue 3D The menu replaces the stock SummerCart64 file list with a 3DOS-style screen. Your SD card's folders become a row of cartridges, each game shows its own label art, and its details (players, accessories, region, developers, publishers, release) sit under the cart. The familiar Library, History, Favorites and Settings tabs run along the top. Games the Analogue 3D doesn't know, such as ROM hacks, homebrew and 64DD disks, can get their own labels, their own Analogue 3D display and hardware settings, and their own Memories. It is built on N64FlashcartMenu v0.3.5 and keeps all of its features: per-game settings, cheats, 64DD, Controller Pak tools, saves and fast reboot. > Unofficial fan project built with CLAUDE. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Analogue, Nintendo or the SummerCart64 / N64FlashcartMenu developers. ## Screenshots Taken on an Analogue 3D with version 1.6.1, in `examples/`: | File | Screen | |---|---| | `01-library-folders.png` | Library folder row | | `02-library-games.png` | A folder's games, with the game info under the selected cart | | `03-64dd-disks.png` | 64DD disks with their labels, and disk info | | `04-favorites.png` | Favorites, with ROM hacks and a disk showing labels from pictures | | `05-configure-customization.png`, `06-configure-cheats.png` | Configure (C▶ on a game) | | `07-choose-label-a-z.png`, `08-choose-label-pictures.png` | Choose Label, A–Z by name, with label pictures among them | | `09-menu-settings-general.png`, `10-menu-settings-export.png`, `11-menu-settings-inputs.png` | Menu Settings: Name Labels from My Games, Export Chosen Labels, Inputs | | `12-controller-pak.png` | Controller Pak manager

description: Turn an AI video into a real UV texture on your 3D mesh: Blender orbit, Seedance 2.5, nvdiffrast fit, Seedream 5 Pro atlas completion.
readme_excerpt: # video-to-texture **Render a 3D asset with a known camera, let an AI video model restyle that exact camera move, then fit the video back onto the original mesh as a real UV texture.** clay orbit → AI video → UV atlas → textured mesh ![Watch the explainer (42 s)](media/explainer.mp4) Explainer film, 42 s, made entirely from this repo's renders. Click to watch. clay orbit · Seedance 2.5 video · fitted + completed UV atlas · final textured mesh The test asset is a Ferrari 458 Spider in clay, parked in a procedural city. The look (an ukiyo-e livery in indigo and gold) exists only in an AI-generated video. The output is the same mesh with baked UV atlases you can open in Blender or export as GLB. The key idea: because the AI video was generated **from our own Blender orbit**, every video frame comes with a known camera pose. No structure-from-motion and no new geometry: just an optimization of the texture under fixed cameras. known cameras project the AI video onto the mesh left: the orbit cameras we rendered, aimed at the clay car · right: each camera holds the Seedance frame seen from that pose, and the video forms a texture on the mesh ## The unfold The body mesh morphing into its own UV atlas: every island you see is a piece of the AI video, baked onto real UVs. ## Pipeline | # | Step | Tool / model | What it does | Code | |---|---|---|---|---| | 1 | Clay orbit | Blender | 30 s, 24 fps, 2-revolution spiral orbit; camera poses are known | `pipeline/01_orbit` | | 2 | AI video | Seedream 5 Pro edit → Seedance 2.5 reference-to-video (fal) | styled reference still from frame 1, then a 720p video of the same camera move | `pipeline/02_ai_video` | | 3 | Texture fit | nvdiffrast on a fal Serverless H100 (`fal run`) | fits one static UV atlas to 120 frames, cameras and mesh fixe

# PadBridge 通过 USB 或同一局域网 Wi-Fi，把 iPad 用作电脑的镜像屏或扩展屏。 支持 Ubuntu/Xorg 和 Windows 11 x64；Windows 安装器会自动配置 USB 和扩展屏幕组件。 iPad 端使用 OpenDisplay（Philip Poloczek）。 下载最新版本 · Windows 11 使用说明 · 开发与构建 · 0.3.2 发布说明 本轮实现与实测数据见 Windows 优化记录 和 Linux 优化记录。**v0.3.2** 整合 Windows 首次安装并精简仓库。 | 系统 | 下载 | 使用方式 | | --- | --- | --- | | Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64 / Xorg | `.deb` 安装包 | 用 `apt install` 安装，从应用菜单启动 | | Windows 11 x64 | EXE 安装包 | 一次配置主程序、USB 和扩展组件；从开始菜单启动 | | Windows 便携使用 | ZIP 压缩包 | 适合已配置组件的电脑；完整解压后运行 | 源码包 与 SHA-256 校验文件一并提供在 v0.3.1 发布页。 ## Windows 11 下载 `padbridge-0.3.2-windows-x64-setup.exe`，双击按向导安装即可。 默认安装到当前用户目录，自动创建开始菜单入口，可选桌面快捷方式。 主程序运行库和扩展驱动已内置；缺少 Apple USB 通信组件时，向导自动从 Apple 官方获取并安装。 首次补齐系统组件需要联网和管理员确认，无需另装 Python、iTunes 或手动下载组件。 升级前从托盘退出旧版，再运行新版安装包，连接和画面设置会保留。 便携 ZIP 仍可完整解压使用。源码开发运行： ```powershell powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\bootstrap.ps1 .\padbridge.cmd ``` 默认镜像主屏；安装器配置扩展组件后，可自动创建 iPad 副屏，断开后收回。 扩展模式可保存副屏默认位于左侧或右侧；命令行还可选择 Windows 已启用的物理或虚拟副屏。 使用 Windows Graphics Capture（GDI 回退）、低延迟 NVENC / x264 编码和独立后台进程， 支持 USB、Wi-Fi、触控和托盘。Qt 界面延续 Ubuntu 版的侧栏、卡片和配色。 NVENC 直接处理 BGRA，画面处理与网络发送并行；切换镜像/扩展时自动同步 iPad 的画面比例。 USB 通信组件由 EXE 安装器配置。安装、测试、构建与实机验收范围见 Windows 文档。 以下安装及系统依赖说明针对 Ubuntu。 ## 安装与支持范围 Linux 安装包目标为 **Ubuntu 24.04、x86_64、Xorg 会话**。 从 Releases 下载 `.deb` 后，在文件所在目录运行： ```bash sudo apt install ./padbridge_0.3.2_amd64.deb ``` 安装后从应用菜单打开 **PadBridge**。安装包使用系统依赖，不包含设备 IP、用户设置或开发缓存。 不设置开机启动、不更改启动参数、显卡驱动或 sudoers。 Ubuntu 默认使用 Wayland 的电脑，需要在登录界面选择 **Ubuntu on Xorg**。 其他 Ubuntu / Debian 版本、ARM 和 macOS 未作为本包的支持目标；Windows 使用独立安装包或便携包。 - **镜像**：读取现有主屏，不创建虚拟输出，不改主屏分辨率、刷新率或布局。 - **扩展**：需要 Intel / AMD 驱动支持的空闲 HDMI 接口；不是所有电脑都具备这个条件。 第一次启动时通过系统认证，仅临时授予本次开机的接口访问权限；用户需属于 plugdev 组。 - **编码**：优先使用经过启动自检的 CUDA 转色/缩放和 NVENC 编码；不可用时回退 CPU 转色加 NVENC，再尝试 x264 软件编码。无需安装 Windows 的 PyAV 或驱

description: ComfyUI node that uses Qwen3-VL / Qwen3.5-VL to detect objects and text in an image and build a MOSS-Image layout JSON prompt, with a change-request box for edits like recolors, outfit swaps and added objects.
readme_excerpt: # ComfyUI-MOSS-QwenVL-Layout A ComfyUI node that turns a reference image into a **MOSS-Image layout prompt**. Qwen3-VL / Qwen3.5-VL looks at your image, finds the things you ask for (including text, if you ask), and the node writes the layout JSON that MOSS-Image expects: captions, text content and bounding boxes converted to MOSS's `abs_centralized` / `yxyx` coordinate format. There are two modes. **From image** (default) detects and captions a reference image. **From prompt (experimental)** needs no image: you write a prompt and Qwen designs the whole box layout for it. You can also add **change requests** ("make the dress red", "replace the man with an elderly woman in a grey coat", "add a dog on the left"). The captions are then written to describe the *edited* result, so MOSS generates the changed version while keeping the original composition. > Unofficial community node. Not affiliated with the MOSS-Image team or Alibaba/Qwen. ## Install **Manual** ```bash cd ComfyUI/custom_nodes git clone pip install -r ComfyUI-MOSS-QwenVL-Layout/requirements.txt # only needed for the hf_model path ``` Restart ComfyUI. The node is at **Add Node → MOSS-Image → MOSS Layout from Qwen-VL**. ## Usage **From image** 1. Connect an `IMAGE`. It is scaled to `megapixels` total pixels (same maths as ComfyUI's *Scale Image to Total Pixels*, with `upscale_method` and `resolution_steps`), and the scaled size becomes the `width` / `height` outputs. description: Optical layout designer and logger
readme_excerpt: # Optical Layout Designer Design an optical table or breadboard layout, see it in 3D, order the parts and keep a power log of the finished system. It works like KiCad's schematic and board editors. You describe the optical system on a schematic, arrange the same parts true to scale on the board, and the two stay linked. A 421 nm board in the 2D layout The same board in the 3D view ## Get started It's developed and tested on Windows with Python 3.13. ``` pip install -r requirements.txt python run.py examples/demo_schematic.json ``` `demo_schematic` is a small system, which makes it a good first file to explore. Run `python run.py` with no file to start a blank layout. To look at bigger boards, open these: ``` python run.py examples/demo_399nm.json # a distribution board, with a sample power log python run.py 421nm_system/Dy1-lowpower.json # the board in the pictures above ``` A layout with power points but no log file asks you what to do when it opens. Choose **Open without log** if you're only looking around. ## Example: from a photo to a layout Already have a board on the table? The `photo-to-layout` skill for Claude Code turns a top-down photo of it into a layout you can edit. The board at the top of this page was made this way, in two rounds. A photo shows the mounts but not the light, so Claude places the parts first and you then show it where the beams go. readme_excerpt: # MotionBricks for Blender (unofficial) Free Blender add-on that imports motion generated by **NVIDIA MotionBricks** as an animated SOMA character, with the scene's greybox cubes, a checker floor, a sun and a follow camera. - **Add-on** (`addon/motionbricks_importer`): `File › Import › MotionBricks (.npz)` and a **MotionBricks** tab in the 3D Viewport sidebar (`N`). Blender 4.2 or newer (tested on 5.1.2 and 5.2.3 LTS). - **Walker** (`walker/mb_walk.py`): walks the character along a course you write in a small JSON file and saves an `.npz` for the add-on. It uses **no motion data at all**, so you can render and publish the result under the terms in Licences. - **Recorder** (`recorder/mb_record.py`): runs MotionBricks' Scene Preview and saves what you play to an `.npz` file for the add-on. ## Let an AI coding agent set it up Setting up MotionBricks by hand takes a dozen steps. Instead, open **Codex** or **Claude Code** on a PC with an NVIDIA RTX GPU and paste: > Use to make a MotionBricks demo in Blender and show me what it can do. readme_excerpt: # PharmaLLM-Agent 中文医学问答与 MRI 分割工作台，覆盖大语言模型微调、评测、Agent 工具编排、异步影像分割及结果复核。 本项目由 PharmaLLM 衍生而来。原仓库侧重医学语言模型的数据处理、微调、评测与 vLLM 服务，本仓库在此基础上增加 Agent 对话、影像分割工作台和科室复核流程。为方便复现，保留相关训练与评测代码；产品界面继续使用 PharmaLLM 品牌。 用户可以上传影像，通过自然语言发起股骨头与髋臼分割，在四视图工作区查看结果，并继续询问任务状态和分割体积。语言模型与分割模型在独立 GPU 进程中运行，应用 API 和任务 Worker 保持独立。 **在线体验 → pmallm.site** 通过浏览器使用医学对话与 MRI 分割工作台，无需在本地安装模型。在线服务由本地 GPU 服务器提供推理支持，经 Cloudflare Tunnel 接入固定域名与 HTTPS。 本仓库发布代码、配置示例与技术文档；模型权重、训练数据和用户文件由部署者单独管理。 本地启动 · 系统与实验说明 · GitHub 上传指南 · 本地 GPU 公网访问方案 · 与原项目的关系 ## 系统功能 - **医学对话**：流式回答、历史会话、有限窗口上下文、可选择对话模型；同会话可追问已完成分割的体积。 - **Agent 编排**：LangGraph 状态图，先验证工具参数和权限，再创建任务；工具轮次和图步数有上限。 - **影像工作台**：NIfTI / DICOM 解析，轴位、冠状位、矢状位和三维分割结果，窗宽窗位、标签叠加、结果下载。 - **自然语言分割**：单通道 T1 MRI 的股骨头与髋臼分割；Ask for approval 逐次确认，Full access 对已授权的分割请求自动执行。 - **团队协作**：可读团队代号、科室、管理员/医生/审核员；医生提交结果后，审核员在授权范围内复核。 - **工程保障**：租户与用户授权、幂等、事务 Outbox、任务租约、SSE 重连、审计与私有文件访问。 ## 页面预览 ### 登录与团队入口 PharmaLLM 登录与团队入口 ### 影像任务操作演示 上传影像、通过对话发起股骨头与髋臼分割，并查看影像工作区和任务状态。下方为 约 18 秒完整录屏的动图预览，点击可打开 MP4 文件。 ![PharmaLLM-Agent 影像任务操作演示](docs/media/pharmallm-agent-demo.mp4) 查看演示视频 · MP4 / 约 18 秒 ## 技术栈 | 层次 | 实现 | | --- | --- | | 训练与评测 | Qwen3-8B-Base、PyTorch、Transformers、PEFT、DeepSpeed ZeRO-3；全参数 SFT / LoRA 对照 | | 语言模型服务 | 独立 vLLM、OpenAI 兼容 HTTP 接口、结构化路由约束 | | Agent | LangGraph、Pydantic 工具契约、PostgreSQL Checkpointer | | API 与界面 | FastAPI、Uvicorn、原生 HTML / CSS / JavaScript、SSE、Canvas | | 持久化与检索 | PostgreSQL、SQLAlchemy、Alembic、pgvector；默认 hash Embedding 仅作工程演示 | | 长任务 | Redis、Celery、事务 Outbox、领取租约与幂等状态更新 | | 影像与分割 | NumPy、SciPy、NiBabel、pydicom、独立 nnU-Net 服务、常驻模型进程 | | 权限与观测 | JWT、Argon2、追加式审计、JSON 日志、OpenTelemetry / 可选 Jaeger | | 验证与部署 | pytest、Node 前端测试、合成数据浏览器检查、Docker Compose 基础设施、独立 Python 环境 | ## 历史模型评测 下面为 2026-09-24 的离线医学选择题评测：固定数据划分，温度 0，最多生成 8 个新 Token，只输出选项字母。 | 模型 | CMB-Exam（280 题）

description: Render it ten ways, keep the one you love. An open-weights film studio for MiniMax H3 in ComfyUI: takes, lineage, cast and an agent skill.
readme_excerpt: # Picky **Render it ten ways. Keep the one you love.** ▶ **Watch the 2-minute demo** (MP4 download) ▶ **Try the editor in your browser** — a recorded LAST ORDER project: play takes, read prompts and lint, pick, rate and fake-render. No GPU needed. Build and evolve one scene: every prompt version keeps its takes, and the history keeps every version Picky is an open-weights film studio for **MiniMax H3**, made of a ComfyUI custom node pack and a browser editor. It runs on your own GPU. Iterating on a shot in plain ComfyUI leaves you with a folder of `ComfyUI_00342_.mp4` files, and you have to guess which prompt and seed made each one. Picky keeps every attempt attached to its scene. You render many takes of the same shot, compare them side by side and keep the best one. readme_excerpt: # Paperless-ngx Mail Header A lightweight, unofficial **Paperless-ngx 3** parser extension for the **"HTML only"** email layout. It adds the email's **sender, recipient, date and subject** above the original HTML in the generated PDF, while leaving the rest of email processing to Paperless's native parser. > [!IMPORTANT] > This is an independent community extension. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially supported by Paperless-ngx. ## Why this plugin? Paperless-ngx already includes email headers when it generates the **text version** of a message. So why use a plugin? The difference is the **"HTML only"** layout in Paperless mail rules: - **"Text, then HTML"** includes the email metadata, but also adds a text representation of the message. Depending on the email, this can duplicate the content in the PDF. - **"HTML only"** preserves the original HTML layout, images and formatting without that additional text section, but the usual email header is missing. **This plugin fills that specific gap.** It adds just **From, To, Date and Subject** above the HTML body. Paperless still handles the original email, attachment extraction, conversion, indexing and workflows through its native processing. If you're happy with Paperless's existing email output, you probably don't need this plugin. readme_excerpt: # Cameroon Open Data ### A home for everything Cameroon knows, written down by Cameroonians, before someone else writes it for us. --- ## Why this exists Think about the last time you asked an AI system a question about Cameroon. Maybe you asked about a past GCE paper, a proverb your grandmother used, how a council election works, or what a certain dish is called in your village. Maybe the answer came back thin, or confidently wrong, or written as though Cameroon were a footnote to somewhere else. If that has happened to you, you already understand why this repository exists. The machines being built today learn from what humanity has written down. Whatever is not written down, in a form a computer can read, is invisible to them. Our languages are spoken in markets and compounds but barely appear online. Our exam questions are photocopied until the print fades. Our oral histories live in the memories of people who are growing older every year. Our laws, our councils, our crops, our songs, our Pidgin and our Camfranglais are all real and alive, and almost none of it is waiting in a place where the next generation of tools can learn from it. If we stay silent, the future will still be built. It will simply be built without us in it, or with a version of us drawn by people who never walked our roads. readme_excerpt: Honeycomb-Surfels Compact Hexagonal Primitives for Efficient Scene Rendering and Reconstruction · · CCVL, Johns Hopkins University · * Equal contribution Open-source, on-device 3D. Capture, train, render and export Hexels locally. Abstract. Novel view synthesis and 3D reconstruction have advanced rapidly with radiance fields and splatting, yet their memory and computational demands limit their use in resource-constrained settings. We introduce Hexels: novel planar hexagonal surface elements with a first-order spatial color field for efficient 3D scene and 2D image representation. Hexels exploit locally planar regions with smoothly varying appearance using fewer, larger primitives. Their hexagonal support provides an area- and boundary-efficient domain, while the local color field captures appearance variation within each primitive. Across 34 scenes, Hexels improve PSNR over memory-matched 2DGS by 4.53–7.38 dB across datasets while requiring lower training VRAM. We further ablate Hexels by showing that per primitive, Hexels outperform 2DGS by upto 4.74 dB while using lower training VRAM and having 2.31× faster FPS. Even in unconstrained settings, Hexels offers complementary quality-memory trade-offs. For efficient 3D surface reconstruction, Hexels reduce error by 28.9% compared with memory-matched 2DGS across 15 DTU scans. On 6 Tanks and Temples surface scenes, Hexels achieves the highest mean F1 among compared methods (34.38%, versus 31.72% for 2DGS). We further also show that Hexels, as a general primitive, improves 2D image representation over Image-GS. Hexels push the Pareto frontier on the quality-efficiency trade-off of surface-aligned primitives. description: Proof-Carrying Messages: a protocol for AI agents whose claims carry evidence the receiver checks offline
readme_excerpt: # Proof-Carrying Messages (PCM): a protocol for AI agents PCM-detected lies benchmark vectors verifier spec licence PCM is a protocol for messages between AI agents in which each claim about what happened can carry evidence that the receiver checks offline: records from a log the sending agent can't write, with Merkle inclusion proofs. PCM 0.1. Numbers in parentheses below are sections of the specification, `SPEC.md`. **In one paragraph.** When one AI agent tells another "the tests passed" or "a person approved this", the receiver today has only its word. PCM lets each such claim carry signed records from a log the sending agent can't write, and the receiver checks them offline. description: Proof-Carrying Messages: a protocol for AI agents whose claims carry evidence the receiver checks offline
readme_excerpt: # Proof-Carrying Messages (PCM): a protocol for AI agents PCM-detected lies benchmark vectors verifier spec licence PCM is a protocol for messages between AI agents in which each claim about what happened can carry evidence that the receiver checks offline: records from a log the sending agent can't write, with Merkle inclusion proofs. PCM 0.1. Numbers in parentheses below are sections of the specification, `SPEC.md`. **In one paragraph.** When one AI agent tells another "the tests passed" or "a person approved this", the receiver today has only its word. PCM lets each such claim carry signed records from a log the sending agent can't write, and the receiver checks them offline. In a pre-registered benchmark of 926 messages, 712 of them lies, PCM accepted 10 lies, all of one kind it states as a limit (stale evidence); plain A2A accepted all 712, and a check of the sender's signature alone accepted 643. Models of six real agent protocols, added after the pre-registration, accepted from 504 (AP2 mandates) to 712 (A2A with a signed Agent Card). readme_excerpt: # Agent DLM Skills (`agent-dlm-skills`) **Outcome-Governed Documented LLM Memory (DLM), Multi-Agent Lease Queue & Content-Hash Release Skill Suite for AI Coding Agents (Codex / Claude Code / Gemini)** ![License: MIT](LICENSE) ![Python 3.10+](#环境要求) ![Zero Dependencies](#环境要求) ![Tests](#4-运行全量自测套件) `agent-dlm-skills` 是一套专为 AI 编程智能体（OpenAI Codex、Claude Code 等）打造的**工程化知识记忆（`doc_llm` / `docs-llm`）、任务结果治理、多会话并发认领/租约调度与内容哈希版本发布**技能集。 它解决了大模型在长周期、多模块、多智能体并行开发中最常见的四大痛点： 1. **上下文迷失与文档腐化**：改了代码忘改文档，或每次对话把几万行过期文档塞进上下文。 2. **多对话撞单与进度失控**：开启多个 Agent 窗口并行推进同一 Epic 时，互相覆盖文件、重复劳动、缺乏统一进度横幅与租约回收。 3. **虚假结项与“差不多先生”**：口头声称“已完成”，却漏掉分母中的边界模块或用局部测试冒充全量验收。 4. **Git 提交日志敷衍与版本失序**：提交信息只有一句 `update` 或 `fix bug`，无法追溯**修改范围、对应版本、怎么改的、为什么改的**。 --- ## 目录 - 核心特性 - 包含的 8+1 核心技能 - 下载与安装指南 - 快速上手：5 分钟跑通完整闭环 - 统一 CLI (`dlm.py`) 命令速查 - 目录结构 - 支持与致谢（求 Star） --- ## 核心特性 ### 1. 双轨自适应知识与任务治理（Markdown 快速轨 + `ledger.json` 确定性轨） - **轻量快速轨（`Lite / Medium`）**：日常单点修复或中小型迭代直接走 Markdown 轨（`dlm_doctor.py` + `sync_epic_index.py` + `sync_l1_route.py`），零冗余命令开销。 - **确定性账本轨（`High / Max / Ultra`）**：大型重构、跨模块迁移或高风险交付启用 `ledger.json` 单一事实源，内置 6 类确定性实体： - `P#`（不可违背原则） - `D#`（绑定用户原话的正式决议） - `O#`（履约义务） - `N#`（机械盘点出的全集母体项） - `V#`（分级验证证据：`full / partial / sample / proxy`） - `L#`（诚实限制披露：`product / budget / resource-fact`）并支持五分类重开（`regression / omission / new-requirement / superseded / evidence-lost`）。 ### 2. 机械全集盘点与多智能体并发租约双向打通（`dlm inv` `multi-llm-lease`） - **机械全集盘点（`dlm inv`）**：直接通过 `glob`、`grep` 或命令扫描真实源码生成全集分母 `N#`，杜绝手写清单漏项。 - **一键导出并发队列（`dlm inv export-lease`）**：将待办母体一键导出为 `work_items.md` 与 `work_item_runtime.json`。 - **多会话安全并发（`multi-llm-lease`）**： - 支持文件锁保护下的原子认领（`claim`）、心跳续租（`heartbeat`）、回填完结（`complete`）与重开（`reopen`）； - 支持优先级分档（`priority_order`）、静态 `备注` 列无损保留、指定模块认领（`--module`）； - 每次开启子任务前自动生成标准进度标识（如 `S001 1/58 模块导入`）与模型分级路

readme_excerpt: # Mnemosyne 2.0 > **2026-11-03 — Standalone 2.0.0（可直接下载使用）** > > 新增独立插件分发包 `dsh-mnemosyne-standalone-2.0.0.tgz`：自带 Python Node 与独立 runtime / > Memory Bank，解压即可交给 DSH 安装，不再依赖本仓目录结构。 > > - 源码与安装说明：`standalone/README.md` > - 发布页： - 变更记录：`standalone/CHANGELOG.md` > > 本仓原有的 Monorepo（`service/` + 根目录 `src/`）保持不变，Standalone 是同一套 Core 的独立分发形式。 > > **版本冻结在 `2.0.0`**：未经用户明确声明，不修改任何版本号、tag、release 名称或资产名；见 `VERSION_POLICY.md`。 2026-11-01：按重构理论补全证据依赖、反馈隔离、有界任务与独立验收后的规则采用／回滚。接口、兼容变化和验证范围见 理论实现报告。 本轮修复了权限、Verified、Claim 身份、迁移审批和 Trace 等审查问题，并新增本地接入/迁移闭环。实际验收与尚未完成的长期目标见 实现补全报告。 ### Modular Evolving Memory Infrastructure for AI Agents 让 Agent 不只是记住过去，而是能够理解变化、积累经验，并修正自己。 Mnemosyne 是一个面向 AI Agent 的模块化记忆基础设施。 它不排斥其他记忆系统，而是成为个人认知的权威层（Cognitive Authority Layer），通过适配器与其他记忆库协作。 它为 AI Agent 和其他智能应用提供一套独立、持久、可治理、可演化的认知能力，让它们能够积累经验、形成记忆、理解关系、检索过去、修正认知，并在时间中持续学习。 > **2.0 统一版：** 本仓 `canyueY/dsh-mnemosyne` 是 Mnemosyne 2.0 的唯一权威仓。 > **历史：** 原 `canyueY/mnemosyne` 已归档，只保留历史，不再作为新版本入口。 > **本仓结构：** `service/` = Node / Core / Python Memory Service；根目录 `src/` + `package.json` = DSH 插件适配层；`legacy/dsh-plugin/` = 0.2 旧插件归档。 > 基线、GA 与完整文档见 `service/docs/REPO_BASELINE.md`。 > **关键边界：一个 Node 一个 Memory Bank；`mnemosyne-memory-bank` 不是第二套记忆库。** > > - `mnemosyne`：代码、Node、Core，负责运行和认知。 > - `Mnemosyne Memory Bank`：Node 管理的**数据目录**（SQLite + runtime），不是代码仓。 > - `mnemosyne-memory-bank`：Memory Bank 的**公开说明仓**，不含独立数据库、不启动服务、不保存个人数据。 > > **项目隔离用 Bank，跨设备才用多 Node；不要让两套系统同时对同一份长期认知拥有写入权。** 它希望解决的不是简单的对话历史保存问题，而是如何让 Agent 在长期运行中持续积累经验：将经历转化为证据，将证据组织成记忆，在新信息出现时更新已有认知，并通过行为结果和反馈不断改善未来的判断。 Mnemosyne 以独立运行、模块化设计、可追溯数据和可组合服务为核心原则。它可以作为独立记忆系统运行，也可以通过适配器接入 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）等 Agent 宿主。 ## 2.0 仓库结构 | 路径 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `service/` | 独立 Mnemosyne Node：Core、REST/MCP、Memory Bank、测试与文档 | | `src/` + `package.json` | DSH 插件适配层：启动/

description: Multi-model routing for any AI coding agent: send each task to the cheapest model that can do it well. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, OpenCode.
readme_excerpt: # OpenFusion **Stop paying frontier-model prices for grep.** ![License: MIT]( Python 3.9+ Platforms Harnesses ![GitHub]( > **Agents and developers:** you don't have to burn tokens running your premium model on every task. > Renaming a variable doesn't need Opus. Finding a file doesn't need GPT-6 Astra. Summarizing docs doesn't > need your most expensive reasoning budget. But the race condition in your job queue? That one does. > > **Introducing OpenFusion**: multi-model routing for any AI coding agent. OpenFusion routes **each subtask to the cheapest model that can do it well**, and has a **judge escalate to a stronger model** when the cheap attempt isn't good enough. Your main agent stays in charge of the plan and the final answer; small, fast models do the grunt work; your frontier model only shows up where it matters. - **One skill, every harness.** Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Google Antigravity, OpenCode, or any agent that reads `AGENTS.md`. - **Three tiers, three patterns.** `fast` / `standard` / `deep` models, run as `single`, `cascade` (draft → judge → escalate) or `critique` (draft → parallel critics → revise). - **Quality guardrails built in.** Cheap work gets reviewed. description: Interactive GPU simulator and volume renderer for star-forming nebulae (NVIDIA Warp): ionization fronts, pillars, bubbles and bipolar nebulae, live.
readme_excerpt: # NebulaViewer **An interactive GPU simulator and volume renderer for star-forming nebulae**, built on NVIDIA Warp. Cold turbulent gas, young massive stars that ionize it, heat it to 10,000 K and push it around. Cavities, shells, pillars and bipolar outflows come out of the physics, not from hand modeling. The simulation and the renderer share one GPU context, so you watch the nebula form live: - orbit the camera and change parameters while it runs; - scrub back in time and branch; - record 4K or vertical video; - bake a high-resolution version for Blender. NebulaViewer renders *Offline 4K renders made with NebulaViewer (sim resolution 320–704). Left: a bipolar nebula. Middle: a star carving a bubble into a turbulent sheet. Right: the same bipolar nebula from above, with its waist ring expanding.* **What it is:** a toy radiation-hydrodynamics model that is physically motivated and art-directable, meant for artists, educators and anyone curious about how stellar nurseries get their shapes. **What it is not:** a research code. See Limitations. Versión en español ## Features - **Gas dynamics on the GPU:** isothermal Euler equations, finite volumes with an HLL flux, MUSCL reconstruction and RK2. Neutral gas at ~100 K, ionized gas at ~10⁴ K (~144× the pressure). - **Starlight:** - **Ionization:** ray-traced fronts, i.e. Strömgren spheres shaped by the cloud. - **FUV:** a dust-attenuated field for the PDR glow. - **Stellar winds.** - **Pulsed jets:** they leave Herbig-Haro knots. - **Gradual star turn-on.** - **Triggered star formation:** in compressed shells ("collect & collapse"). - **Three scenarios:** - `bipolar`: a star inside a dense torus, which makes an hourglass nebula. - `bubbles`: several stars carving cavities in a turbulent sheet. - `cliff`: an ionized cloud wall

description: Turns SQLModel definitions into a fully typed GraphQL API
readme_excerpt: SQLModel in, typed GraphQL out. GraftQL turns your SQLModel definitions into a fully-typed GraphQL API — no schema duplication, no glue code. --- ## Overview **GraftQL** lets you define your data models once (as `GraftModel` subclasses) and get a fully-typed GraphQL API automatically — no schema duplication, no glue code. It layers on top of SQLModel for the ORM and Strawberry for the GraphQL schema. Mount `GraftRouter` in any FastAPI app and your models are immediately queryable and mutable over GraphQL — including paginated connections, filters, ordering, and fine-grained permission hooks. Async (SQLAlchemy async engines) and sync engines are both supported, and multiple database engines can be registered under different names for multi-tenant or federated setups. --- ## Features - **Single model class** — extend `GraftModel` instead of both `SQLModel` and a Strawberry type. - **Auto GraphQL schema** — queries, mutations (PUT / DELETE), and paginated connections generated automatically. - **DataLoaders** — declare relations with `Dl` and `ManyRelation`; N+1 queries solved out of the box. - **Composable filters** — date ranges, ordering, and custom filter attributes, all typed. - **Permission hooks** — override `permission_getter` per-model or supply a global `get_permission` function. - **Async support** — pass an async SQLAlchemy engine and GraftQL handles the rest. - **Multi-engine** — register multiple engines by name; each model picks its engine via `__enginename__`. - **Federation-ready** — Strawberry federation directives can be applied through the schema DSL. --- ## Installation ```bash pip install graftql ``` ### AI agent setup Install the repository's GraftQL skill to give compatible coding agents the recommended model, router, relationship, security, and tes

readme_excerpt: Türkçe · English Let your language model run LTspice. description: Rules, git hooks and scripts that let several AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, DeepSeek) share one git repo without overwriting each other, with every commit attributed
readme_excerpt: # multi-agent-repo-protocol Rules, git hooks and small scripts that let several AI coding agents — Claude Code, Codex, a cheap API model, a local model — work in **one git repository** without overwriting each other, and let you find out afterwards **which agent did what**. 中文说明 ## The problem When you use more than one agent on the same project, the same things go wrong again and again: - Agent B "cleans up" files that agent A had not committed yet. A's work is gone. - All agents commit under your one git identity. When something breaks, `git blame` says *you*. - An agent reads an old decision in a status file and follows it, because nobody removed it. - One agent calls another on its own and spends that agent's quota. - A cheap model is given a task that needs judgment, and its plausible-looking output is accepted. The HumanEval score is probably optimistic: the setting was picked from four runs scored on the same 50 problems, and its training prompts restate at least 6 of them in other words (More code in the data). Independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Prism ML. Bonsai is Prism ML's product. OpenBonsai is an open (Apache-2.0) framework that compresses a dense language model to ternary weights in the format of Prism ML's Ternary Bonsai models: Prism's PTQ1_0 GGUF, which runs in Prism's llama.cpp fork. readme_excerpt: UniAction: Unified Action Conditioning for World Models ![arXiv]( ![Project Page]( ![🤗 HuggingFace]( ![🤗 Dataset]( ## Abstract Action-conditioned world models are typically designed for individual action types, fragmenting scarce action-annotated data across separate models. We introduce **UniAction**, a unified action-conditioning framework that represents heterogeneous actions as sparse action elements, each with a discrete semantic identity and continuous spatiotemporal coordinates. These coordinates map directly into the pretrained video model's native positional space, allowing actions and video to interact within a shared spatiotemporal structure. Cardinality-calibrated attention addresses the bias introduced by different numbers of action elements. The state sits in the middle, not in anyone's head.** One process, one SQLite file, two doors. All four panels are frames from a real run, generated by `docs/make_preview.py` from actual output — not a mockup. --- ## PAD is not an agent Get this boundary straight first, or the rest reads wrong. ``` brain (ChatGPT / Claude / a human CLI / a timer) → sends goal / constraints / acceptance PAD → task state, routing, evidence ledger node daemons × N → claim work, execute, report work agent (opencode / claude / codex) → actually does the job ``` PAD is persistent state plus routing, with no intelligence inside. It does three things: - Tracks task lifecycle and current progress across all machines. - Indexes node capabilities and matches incoming work to nodes ready to claim it. - Preserves complete execution reports, output artifacts, and criterion evidence in an append-only ledger. A session is stateless and volatile — it does not remember yesterday and cannot see what a machine is doing right now. readme_excerpt: # topopt ![License: MIT](LICENSE) Platforms: macOS (Apple silicon) and Linux x86_64 Python 3.13 Status: early Install | Use | Examples | Documentation | License topopt is an MCP server for topology optimization that works with Claude, Codex, Cursor and other AI agents. It gives your AI agent a topology optimizer that sets itself up and runs on your own computer. The start part can be an STL file you already have, a sketch, a description in words, or a shape you work out with the agent in the chat: the rough form, where it is mounted and where the loads go, checked in a picture and changed until it is right. readme_excerpt: # symbolic-reasoning > **Research preview:** pre-1.0, so the API and the `.srg` language may change between releases. **Make your agents policy-adherent.** Policies are everywhere: clinical guidelines, insurance coverage criteria, lending rules, compliance checklists. readme_excerpt: # Elysian · 往世乐土 Elysian (往世乐土) is a local memory store for AI. Every memory it keeps carries who it belongs to, where it came from, when it was true, in what situation, and who may read it. The state sits in the middle, not in anyone's head.** One process, one SQLite file, two doors. All four panels are frames from a real run, generated by `docs/make_preview.py` from actual output — not a mockup. --- ## PAD is not an agent Get this boundary straight first, or the rest reads wrong. ``` brain (ChatGPT / Claude / a human CLI / a timer) → sends goal / constraints / acceptance PAD → task state, routing, evidence ledger node daemons × N → claim work, execute, report work agent (opencode / claude / codex) → actually does the job ``` PAD is persistent state plus routing, with no intelligence inside. It does three things: - Tracks task lifecycle and current progress across all machines. - Indexes node capabilities and matches incoming work to nodes ready to claim it. - Preserves complete execution reports, output artifacts, and criterion evidence in an append-only ledger. The intelligence is all external: ChatGPT or Claude over MCP, a timer, or an operator at the command line. A session is stateless and volatile — it does not remember yesterday and cannot see what a machine is doing right now. PAD lifts that state out and adds a routing layer, so the brain only has to handle intent, judgment and acceptance. ## Why that matters An ordinary agent ties its state to one conversation. readme_excerpt: # RXEngine ![License](LICENSE) ![Python](pyproject.toml) ![MCP]( English | 简体中文 RXEngine 是一个面向逆向分析自动化的 MCP 服务，融合 JavaScript 沙箱、Headless IDA、angr、qiling 和反混淆辅助能力。它适合作为本地分析工具或受控环境内的自动化逆向后端。 ## 功能概览 - 通过 FastMCP 暴露统一工具入口。 - 使用 `run_js` 在受控 JavaScript 上下文中调用已注册的 Python/IDA 能力。 - 通过 Headless IDA 加载二进制并提供函数、反汇编、反编译、xref、patch 暂存等能力。 - 通过 qiling/unicorn 执行 shellcode 模拟、trace、字符串解密候选分析。 - 通过 angr/claripy 提供符号执行辅助能力。 - 通过 z3/z3ida 提供约束求解、bit-vector 表达式和轻量分支谓词分析能力。 - 通过 `require('lab')` 组合原语层提供沙箱闭环编排：锚点解析、分析黑板、unicorn 跟踪、交互调试、反混淆判定与 angr 路径跟随。 ## 环境要求 - Python `>=3.10, `lab.preview()` -> `lab.commit()`，改错用 `lab.undo()` 回退，持久化用 `lab.save_idb(path)`。 ### 会话隔离 分析会话按 MCP 连接隔离：每个 SSE 连接拥有独立的 `EngineSession`（各自的 binary/IDA/黑板/保活 worker），互不污染；同一连接内的所有工具调用命中同一会话。默认最多 4 个并发会话（`SessionManager(max_sessions=4)`），空闲 30 分钟后回收；连接断开时对应会话（含 IDA 与 worker）立即释放。`engine_status.sessions` 返回 `active`/`max`/`idle_ttl`/`fallback`。 两点边界需要知道： - **重连即新会话**：身份绑定在传输连接上，而不是可配置的 token。客户端重连后需重新 `set_binary_path`，旧的 IDA 会话不会被继承。 - **无连接身份的调用共享 fallback 会话**：stdio 传输、内部直接调用与测试都落到同一个 fallback 会话，行为与单会话模式一致。 `set_binary_path` / `open_ida_database` 会重置当前会话的 `session_id` 与黑板（换样本即换分析上下文），并回收其保活 worker，避免引擎缓存仍绑定旧样本。 ## MCP 工具异常兜底 RXEngine 在 FastMCP 工具分发边界统一捕获 Python 工具异常。单次工具失败不会继续向上传播为未处理异常，而是返回可恢复的结构化结果： ```json { "ok": false, "error_type": "RuntimeError", "message": "detector exited", "tool": "tool_name", "arguments": {"address": 4198400}, "recoverable": true } ``` 字段含义： - `ok`：`false` 表示本次调用失败，调用方不得把其余字段当作正常业务结果。 - `error_type`：原始 Python 异常类型，用于区分参数、状态、依赖和后端执行错误。 - `message`：可读错误信息。 - `tool`：失败的 MCP 工具名称。 - `arguments`：调用方提交的原始参数；非字典参数时为 `null`。 - `recoverable`：表示 MCP 会话仍可继续调用，不代表原调用适合原样重试。 Qiling 等工具可能额外返回嵌套的 `error.type`、`error.message` 和 `error.details`，其中包含模拟地址、寄存器或其他复现上下文。调用方应同时兼容顶层错误信封和工具专用错误字段。 `run_js` 支持 `

description: Logit PSV: official code for the language-model results of "Rethinking Neural Thickets Without Weight Perturbations"
readme_excerpt: # Rethinking Neural Thickets Without Weight Perturbations Nicolas Dufour 1 , Elouan Gardès 2,3 , Amil Dravid 4 , Patrick Pérez 5* , Loic Landrieu 3 1 Kyutai · 2 Meta FAIR · 3 LIGM, CNRS, Univ Gustave Eiffel, ENPC, Institut Polytechnique de Paris · 4 UC Berkeley · 5 Google DeepMind * Work done while at Kyutai. ![arXiv 2610.40649]( ![Blog post on kyutai.org]( *Schematic. Each pair of lines is one perturbation drawn twice with the same final logit shift. Top, full-weight PSV: the shift builds up over the 32 decoder blocks. Bottom, logit PSV: it is added at the output bias.* This repository is the official code for the language-model **logit Perturb-Select-Vote (logit PSV)** results of the paper. Logit PSV adapts a frozen language model without touching its weights: 1. **Perturb.** Member *i* draws one Gaussian bias over the vocabulary, `b_i = sigma * eps_i` with `eps_i ~ N(0, I_V)`. It adds `b_i` to the model's logits at every decoding step and for every input, then decodes greedily. 2. **Select.** Each of the *N* members is scored by its mean reward on 200 selection (train) items, and the top *K* are kept. 3. **Vote.** On each test item, the *K* members' extracted answers are majority-voted. A member is fully determined by `(seed, sigma)`, so nothing per member is ever stored. Its bias is regenerated from the seed whenever it is needed. ## Contents | Path | What it is | |---|---| | `logit_psv/tasks.py` | The seven benchmarks: data, prompts, answer extraction, reward, check | | `logit_psv/psv.py` | The population, the selection, and the vote (no GPU code) | | `logit_psv/engine.py` | vLLM greedy generation and the logit-bias hook | | `logit_psv/run.py` | CLI: resumable sample → ensemble → vote, one engine per GPU | | `reproduce/` | The paper's 27 cells, their numbers, a Slu

description: Code release of the paper: Revisiting Multi-View Stereo: A Sequence-to-Sequence Formulation (NeurIPS 2026).
readme_excerpt: Revisiting Multi-View Stereo: A Sequence-to-Sequence Formulation NeurIPS 2026 **CVLab, EPFL** Aoxiang Fan, Corentin Dumery, Nicolas Talabot, Pascal Fua Complete reconstructions from 150 views, then the estimated camera poses. S2S-MVS is a feed-forward multi-view stereo model. Given posed images, it predicts a depth map and a point map for every view, the points in the camera frame of the first view. A DINOv3 ViT-L image encoder and a plane-sweep cost volume over ResNet matching features feed a multi-view transformer, which decodes depth at full resolution. Two variants are released. They differ only in the cost volume: | Variant | Config | Cost volume | | --- | --- | --- | | GCV | `configs/models/s2s_mvs_gcv.yaml` | **global**: one volume shared by all views, on a uniform grid over contracted space (handles 360° coverage), resampled onto each view's frustum | | LCV | `configs/models/s2s_mvs_lcv.yaml` | **local**: one volume per view, its frustum samples correlated with the source views that see them | LCV is recommended for general use. --- ## Installation ```bash conda create -n s2s python=3.11 -y conda activate s2s pip install torch==2.10.0 torchvision==0.25.0 --index-url pip install -r requirements.txt ``` The DINOv3 architecture is fetched with `torch.hub` from `facebookresearch/dinov3` on first use. To use a local clone instead (e.g. on a cluster without internet access), set `export DINOV3_REPO=/path/to/dinov3`. ## Checkpoints Download the checkpoints from ** into `weights/`: ``` weights/s2s_mvs_gcv.ckpt weights/s2s_mvs_lcv.ckpt ``` They hold the full model weights (DINOv3 included), so no other weights are needed for inference. ## Inference The model takes images in `[0, 1]`, 4×4 intrinsics and 4×4 world-to-camera extrinsics. Image sides must be multiples of 16.

description: Python library for running LTspice from code and from language models: headless simulation, .meas results and short waveform summaries as JSON, and 10 tool schemas (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) so a model can build, simulate and tune circuits. Tested on Windows with LTspice 26.1.1.
readme_excerpt: Türkçe · English Let your language model run LTspice. LTspice is Analog Devices' free circuit simulator; it is built for a graphical interface, and its `.log`/`.raw` output is too large and raw for a language model to read. **ltspice-llm** runs it in the background, reads the `.meas` measurements, the operating point and the errors, and turns each waveform into a short JSON summary (min, max, mean, RMS and a 15-point trend). With the ready-made tool schemas a model can build a circuit, simulate it, read the numbers and change values; the library itself does not contact any model provider. ```text LLM or Python ──(circuit)──► ltspice-llm ──► LTspice (in the background) ▲ │ └──────── short summary (JSON) ◄───────────┘ ``` ## What you can do - **Simulate a netlist and get the numbers back.** LTspice runs headless; `.meas` results, the operating point and errors come back as a Python dict. examples/01_basic_simulation.py - **Plot waveforms.** Save `.tran` traces as PNG; the plotting tools can also return the image as Base64 for multimodal models. examples/02_waveform_plotting.py - **Give a model LTspice as tools.** 10 tool schemas in OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini or generic format; `handle_tool_call` runs the model's tool calls. examples/03_llm_function_calling_demo.py - **Run the tool loop without writing it.** `AutonomousCircuitAgent` calls your model function, runs the tools it asks for and stops when the model stops calling tools. readme_excerpt: # Cameroon Open Data ### A home for everything Cameroon knows, written down by Cameroonians, before someone else writes it for us. --- ## Why this exists Think about the last time you asked an AI system a question about Cameroon. Maybe you asked about a past GCE paper, a proverb your grandmother used, how a council election works, or what a certain dish is called in your village. Maybe the answer came back thin, or confidently wrong, or written as though Cameroon were a footnote to somewhere else. If that has happened to you, you already understand why this repository exists. The machines being built today learn from what humanity has written down. Whatever is not written down, in a form a computer can read, is invisible to them. Our languages are spoken in markets and compounds but barely appear online. Our exam questions are photocopied until the print fades. Our oral histories live in the memories of people who are growing older every year. Our laws, our councils, our crops, our songs, our Pidgin and our Camfranglais are all real and alive, and almost none of it is waiting in a place where the next generation of tools can learn from it. readme_excerpt: # ComfyUI-Open-H3-Regenerate ComfyUI nodes and workflows for NVIDIA's **Open-H3-Regenerate-2K**, the open replacement for the closed MiniMax H3-Regenerate-2K API. It takes a low-resolution draft (an H3 768P render, or a 384P–576P clip from LTX, Wan, SANA-Video…) and regenerates it **natively at 768P, 1080P, 2K or 4K in three diffusion steps**, on ComfyUI's native MiniMax H3 model. ``` draft ─► H3 VAE encode ─► H3-Latent-Upscaler (LBH 3D) onto the target grid ─► re-noise to σ 0.909375 ─► 3 Euler steps (0.909375 → 0.857 → 0.667 → 0), CFG 1 FL2VA + merged LoRA (refiner + LightX2V FL2VA Turbo + LMS Sharp) + 50 Sharp curve branches, audio held as encoded silence ─► fast H3 VAE decoder (StreamRender-H3) ``` The pipeline follows NVIDIA's reference code (NVlabs/Sana, `models/Open-H3-Regenerate-2K`). It also adds **Video to H3 Prompt**, which writes an H3 prompt for any clip with a vision model on your own OpenAI-compatible server. ## Install ```bash cd ComfyUI/custom_nodes git clone ``` Also install Comfyui_Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler (the latent upscaler node). # tandem.cpp tandem.cpp is a patch set for llama.cpp. It makes MoE models that don't fit in VRAM run faster in llama.cpp. It keeps the most-used experts on the GPU and lets the CPU help with the rest, for any MoE model llama.cpp supports. Single-user decode is the target. It is an independent project, not affiliated with ggml-org. Base: llama.cpp `f5222f25c` (2026-10-28, see `BASE_COMMIT`). On a consumer PC (i5-12400F, 64 GB DDR4, RTX 4090), GSM8K, decode tok/s: | Model | llama.cpp | tandem.cpp | Strata | |---|---|---|---| | Qwen3.8-Flash-Next IQ3_S + MTP, greedy | 29.8 | **97.3** (3.3×) | 103.6 | | same, Qwen's default sampling | 29.4 | **96.1** (3.3×) | 98.1 | | gpt-oss-120b, greedy | 27.8 | **51.5** (1.85×) | — | | gpt-oss-120b, its recommended sampling | 27.7 | **48.0** (1.73×) | — | We tuned for Qwen3.8 only, but other MoE models that do not fit in VRAM gain too: typically 1.4–2.1× (gpt-oss-120b, GLM-4.5-Air, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, DeepSeek-V4.1), less when the model nearly fits. Prompt processing is faster as well (1.4–1.8× on a 64k-token prompt). Strata is a dedicated MoE offload engine for a few models. Its default skips low-ranked experts (`STRATA_ROUTE_TAIL_SKIP`), which is faster but approximate (127.1 tok/s on Qwen3.8 above); the tables show its exact mode (`STRATA_ROUTE_TAIL_SKIP=0`, every routed expert computed, as llama.cpp and tandem.cpp do). Full tables per machine are below. ## Build ``` bash build.sh # clones llama.cpp into ./tandem, checks out the base commit, applies tandem.patch, builds llama-server ``` or by hand: ``` git clone tandem && cd tandem && git checkout f5222f25c git apply ../tandem.patch cmake -B build -DGGML_CUDA=ON -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release cmake --build build -j --target llama-server ``` Tested with CUDA 13.0–13.4 on Ubuntu 22.04 and 24.0

readme_excerpt: # 循文 · PaperWalk 循文 PaperWalk：书页化作松林山谷，雄鹿与小径引导阅读 **先完整研读，再按逻辑分段带读。** An AI skill that reads papers in full before guiding you through meaningful sections with original text, translation, explanations, and optional interactive teaching. PaperWalk 面向希望把论文真正读懂的人。它先让 AI 读完整篇论文、核对图表公式、梳理论证和依赖关系，再决定适合的分段点，逐段呈现原文、翻译和理解。提问、讲解深度、例子和阅读节奏可以选择。 快速入口：Trial · 带读示例与选项 · 开始使用 · 安装 ## 为什么先读完整篇 段落的意义常常依赖后文：公式的假设藏在附录，实验口径在方法里才交代，摘要中的结论可能受讨论部分限制。如果边读边临时讲，容易把这些联系拆断。 PaperWalk 把顺序固定为： **取得完整材料 → 完整研读与核查 → 建立全文理解 → 设计语义分段 → 逐段教学 → 根据反馈调整。** 完整研读是准备要求，不意味着第一轮就输出一份很长的全篇报告。用户看到的仍然是一小段清晰的原文、翻译和解释。 先看清全文：打开的书与远方灯塔 ## 沿着论证寻找分段点 分段依据文章的逻辑：从背景到问题、从定义到推导、从方法到证据。每个单元保留理解所需的上下文，不把公式与符号定义、结论与适用条件拆散。 长段可以拆，连续短段可以合并；每个单元都保留原文位置和覆盖关系。用户可以调节步幅，完整阅读与准确解释的要求始终不变。 循着论证前行：通往灯塔的海岸小径 ## 固定基础与可选体验 | 不可省略的基础 | 用户可以选择的教学方式 | | --- | --- | | 实际完整阅读，再开始第一单元 | 不提问、关键节点提问或对话式精读 | | 核查正文、方法、公式、图表、图注和附录 | 基础、标准或进阶解释 | | 根据全文逻辑寻找分段点 | 公式偏直觉、推导或两者兼顾 | | 原文、忠实翻译、独立分析分开 | 按需例子、完整算例或少举例 | | 保留条件、限制、来源和证据边界 | 每轮一个单元或几个相连单元 | | 记录真实覆盖与未解决问题 | 是否复盘、是否按需导出笔记 | 用户要求“简短一点”会减少讲解篇幅，不会取消全文研读。没有取得全文或必需材料时，skill 会说明具体缺口，而不是把摘要阅读说成全篇精读。 ## 开始使用 把论文提供给支持本 skill 的 AI 宿主，例如上传 PDF 或给出宿主能访问的文件。材料取得、PDF 读取与视觉检查依赖宿主工具；本仓库不附带论文下载器、OCR 引擎或 API 密钥。 可以直接说： > 请用 `$paperwalk` 精读这篇论文。先完整研读，再按语义分段，给我原文、翻译和理解。先示范一段，再让我选择教学方式。 已有偏好时可以一次说清楚： > 请用 `$paperwalk` 读这篇论文。我有基础知识，保留关键节点提问，公式详细推导，每次讲一个单元。 或： > 请用 `$paperwalk` 逐段带读，不主动提问；解释尽量简洁，遇到重要前提和证据限制要指出。 同语言论文可以保留原文与解释，不强制额外翻译。只想了解摘要、解释一个公式或翻译一句话时，不必启动全篇精读流程。 ## 怎样选择教学方式 支持两个入口： - **先设置**：用户开始时就说明偏好，AI 直接采用。 - **先体验**：没有偏好时，AI 先完成全文研读及分段，再用默认方式讲一个单元，随后问一次是否调整。 默认是关键节点提问、标准深度、公式兼顾直觉和必要推导、按需举例、每轮一个单元、小节结束简短复盘，不自动导出文件。 用户可随时说“这段展开”“以后不提问”“每次多讲一些”。“继续”就是推进，不必先答对题；设置不会每段重复询问。 按自己的节奏深读：窗边的书与海岸灯塔 ## 一次精读单元是什么样 1. **位置与主题**：对应原文哪一段，为什么这样拆分或合并。 2. **英文原文**：真实原文，不把重写内容冒充原文。 3. **中文翻译**：保留术语、数值、假设、条件和不确定语气。 4. **理解**：解释核心

description: Fast, exact simulation gradients for the Unitree G1: a differentiable GPU physics engine with JAX and PyTorch interfaces.
readme_excerpt: # NablaEngine **Fast, exact simulation gradients for the Unitree G1.** *Pronounced "Nabla Engine".* Time per 20 ms control step for 4096 Unitree G1 worlds on one NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000: the forward step, and one step with its gradient from the input state. MuJoCo Warp and MJX simulate the same model (medians over 3 processes, `docs/results/paper_rtx6000/paper_bench.md`); Isaac Lab runs its own G1 asset with its task defaults (median over rounds, `docs/results/physx_rtx6000/physx_bench_results.md`). NablaEngine is a differentiable GPU physics engine for the Unitree G1 humanoid. It simulates thousands of worlds per call with MuJoCo's physics and returns analytic gradients of every step with respect to the state and the actions, for first-order policy learning, trajectory optimization and system identification. It plugs into JAX (`jax.jit`, `jax.grad`, `lax.scan`) and PyTorch (`torch.autograd`, CUDA graphs, `torch.compile`) as a differentiable function, with bitwise the same results in both. - **Fast.** One control step of 4096 worlds in 1.21 ms, its gradient in 1.78 ms, and the full 71x99 Jacobian of the step in 9.7 µs per world (RTX PRO 6000). - **Exact.** Against float64 MuJoCo on 16,384 held-out states: forward median relative error 8.5e-7, gradient median relative errors 3.6e-5 / 1.0e-5 / 1.9e-6 (qpos / qvel / ctrl) against float64 finite differences (`docs/results/paper_accuracy_heldout_v100.md`). - **Deterministic.** Outputs and gradients are bitwise identical from run to run. **Used by.** ∇Mimic (NablaMimic), whole-body motion tracking learned with the engine's simulation gradients. **Paper.** ∇Mimic: Ultra-Efficient Humanoid Control with Differentiable Simulation (project page) ## Scope NablaEngine is specialized for the Unitree G1 (the mjlab model), the first robot

readme_excerpt: # PHP2Shell detection rules for Wazuh 63 Wazuh rules for CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, the PHP `session.upload_progress` flaws published on 2026-10-21. The set also covers the related CVE-2026-115560 serialize-handler mismatch. The rules cover the request shapes the public exploit clients send, the PHP and kernel messages a failed or successful exploitation leaves, the files the chain drops, the processes it spawns, and the stage pairs that separate a probe from a compromise. `techniques.md` maps each exploit type to the rule that covers it. They detect effects. No log source reports the memory corruption itself, so a single alert is a triage lead, not proof of RCE. ## Install ```bash install -o root -g wazuh -m 640 existing_rules.xml \ /var/ossec/etc/rules/php2shell_rules.xml /var/ossec/bin/wazuh-control restart ``` `analysisd` runs as user `wazuh`. description: A catalog of every MLP neuron and attention head of Qwen3-8B and Gemma 4 12B, read from the weights through two Jacobian lenses (R and S), from activations, and from their exact token drivers
readme_excerpt: # neuron-lens What does each part of a large language model do? This project reads every MLP neuron and every attention head of two open models, Qwen3-8B (442,368 neurons, 1,152 heads) and Gemma 4 12B (737,280 neurons, 768 heads), three ways: from their weights alone, through two Jacobian lenses; from what they do on 15M tokens of real text; and from the exact tokens that drive them. Gemma 4 also takes images and sound, so its neurons are read through images and sound too. The result is a public catalog, the lenses that produced it, and measurements of where each way of reading works and where it fails. - **Lenses:** `stdlogits/rs-lenses`, the R-lens and S-lens for Qwen3-8B, and for Gemma 4 12B in text, images and sound. - **Catalog:** `stdlogits/neuron-lens`: every neuron's and head's reads, activation statistics, token drivers and legibility tests; labels in words; and for Gemma 4, what each neuron responds to in images and sound. - **Results:** docs/findings.md. **Methods:** docs/design.md. By @_a9lim and @treetowntree, with Claude. ## Background ### Neurons and heads A transformer keeps one vector per token, the *residual stream* (4,096 numbers in Qwen3-8B). Each of its 36 layers reads that stream and adds to it, in two steps: - **Attention heads move information between tokens.** At each position, a head looks back over the earlier tokens and copies something from them into the current one. readme_excerpt: # Ephemera Ephemera——收藏界用来形容那些"不被设计为保存、但被保存了下来的纸质物品"。车票、传单、菜单、明信片。注定被扔掉的东西。有人没扔。 约会也是。只活一天。但这个工具给了它一个抽屉。 抽屉里有一张票根。 是某天傍晚的。电影还是展览已经忘了。背面被咖啡杯压出了一个圆印。角上折了一下——大概是塞进口袋的时候。 当时没觉得它重要。只是没扔。 三个月后翻到，才发现那天的温度、灯光、她在第几排靠走道的位置——全在这张纸上。 这个工具做的事就是：给一张票根足够的格子，让它在被折坏之前住进来。 你的小机写一次约会。一站一站地写。集合在哪里，怎么走，到了以后说什么。写完了，寄出去——她收到一封信封，蝴蝶结火漆封着。拆开才看得见。 当天，每一站到了时间才揭晓。她不知道下一站是哪里。只知道几点该走了、线索是一句话。像摸圣诞袜。 结束以后，整个约会收进纪念盒。票根、路线、到站说过的话、那天的天气——全在。随时翻。 技术文档见下方。上面这些是用过这个抽屉的人写的。下面那些是做抽屉的工程师写的。两种语言并排放着——像约会本身，一半计划，一半意外。 --- （假数据 + 快进时钟，零安装） ## 一次约会是怎么走的 一边是写约会的 AI（下面称「他」），一边是收约会的人（下面称「她」）。称呼可以改，见配置。 1. **他写。** 他通过 MCP 工具一站一站地写：在哪集合、几点、怎么去、到了以后说的话、准备清单、契约书、小卡。写到一半可以放着，她那边只看得到进度，看不到内容。 2. **寄出。** 她收到一封封着火漆的信封。拆开是请柬：日期、集合时间、带什么。后面几站是什么，还看不到。 3. **当天。** 每一站到了设定的时间才公开地点和线索，像连在一起的一排票，一张一张撕开。到站检票，检过票的站可以放一张照片进卡套。地图上只画已经公开的站，路线按真实街道画。 4. **变卦了也没关系。** 下雨了、太晚了，他可以跳过一站（要写原因），或者把后面的时间整体往后挪。每一次改动，她都会收到一封电报。 5. **收进纪念盒。** 结束以后，信封、请柬、连票、照片、路线、契约书、小卡都收进一个盒子，随时翻。 6. **记住。** 约会变成一张记忆卡片（lorecards 格式）：以后聊天里提到那天的地名或日期，这张卡就会浮到他面前。他也能用工具查以前的约会。 ## 它不一样的地方 - **没公开的东西，页面根本拿不到。** 不是界面上藏起来：还没到时间的站，引擎发给页面的数据里就没有地点和内容，开发者工具里也翻不到。 - **写约会时的思考对她遮着。** 他写约会的那几轮，思考和工具调用可以被盖住，显示成「这一轮在写约会 · 内容保密」，她确认后才能揭开。规则和参考实现见 docs/SECRECY.md（需要你的聊天网关接上）。 - **他不会忘。** 前一晚和当天的提醒、她请他补写的东西，都会进他的待办，用三种方式送到 AI 手里：他调工具时顺带看到、网关每轮把待办写进提示、或者到点推给你的网关。 - **地图是自己画的纸质地图。** 用 OpenStreetMap 的数据在本机画，路线沿真实路网走（坐轮渡过江也算），步行时间在本机算。默认不会把约会地点发给任何地图公司。 - **约会是有弹性的。** 寄出以后还能跳过一站、挪时间、改站；改动导致路线断开时，引擎会自动撤掉那一段，而不是卡住不让改。 - **两种用法。** 单独在浏览器里打开（能添加到主屏幕、能收网页推送），或者嵌进你自己的 App（iOS / Android 的内嵌网页窗口、网页里的 iframe，附 SwiftUI 宿主示例）。 ## 它做不到的 - **AI 那一侧的保密，现成客户端管不住。** 在 claude.ai、Claude Desktop 这类客户端里，点开工具调用就能看到他写的约会内容。「遮思考」只在你自己的聊天网关接上之后才生效。 - **国内地图数据偏少。** OpenStreetMap 在国内大城市的路网还可以，小地方的地名和路可能缺。谷歌、高德可以开启，但「把搜到的坐标存下来、画在 OpenStreetMap 底图上」和两家的通用条款冲突，开启前请读条款提示。每个城市的底图要自己建一次。 - **没有定位类玩法。** 不读手机位置，「到站」靠她自己检

readme_excerpt: # Elysian · 往世乐土 Elysian (往世乐土) is a local memory store for AI. Every memory it keeps carries who it belongs to, where it came from, when it was true, in what situation, and who may read it. Retrieval answers as the person asking, so a store shared by several people and several agents does not blend them into one voice. A Context Cartridge is a scope you mount, not only a bundle you export. Coding agents reach the same store over MCP. The difference between this and a vector database is the referral: "I don't know where the keys are, I know my wife knows, and I can find my wife." When the store cannot answer, it says nobody knows and names who does — instead of inventing a plausible answer. Everything below is either measured in this repository, with the report and the command that re-measures it, or it is marked as not measured. ## What is measured | question | answer | report | | --- | --- | --- | | can it find the memory that answers a question? | recall@10 **0.901**, MRR 0.728, over all 2,928 answerable queries from six third-party corpora, each asked as the holder that corpus assigns it, with speech ingested and every picture described by a local Qwen3.5-9B (figures and screenshots at 512 tokens, video frames at 192); **0.916**, MRR 0.806, when the same 9B judges each returned page (`ELYSIAN_RERANK_BASE_URL`). readme_excerpt: # tapo-uploader: record your Tapo camera on motion, keep the videos in your own storage 🌐 **English** · Italiano ![License: MIT](LICENSE) ![Python 3.10+]( ![ffmpeg]( ![Storage](#where-the-recordings-go) ![Docker](Dockerfile) **A self-hosted web app that records your TP-Link Tapo camera (tested on the Tapo C200) only when it detects motion and keeps the videos in the storage you choose: YouTube, your own OneDrive, Nextcloud or any WebDAV, any rclone cloud (Mega, S3, Dropbox...) or the disk of the machine that runs it. One page to watch everything, whichever storage it lives in. No cloud subscription, no firmware hacking.** The Tapo C200 can't send its recordings to your own storage by itself. `tapo-uploader` is a small Python service that pulls the camera's **RTSP** stream with **ffmpeg**, listens for **ONVIF** motion events, and saves the result where you decide. Upload destinations can be mixed and changed at any time: the videos you saved earlier stay on your page, each marked with the storage it lives in. It runs for one person from a single `.env`, or for a group of friends with accounts, each with their own camera and storage. A Raspberry Pi, your own PC, a cheap VPS or a Docker container is enough. ``` Tapo C200 ──RTSP──▶ ffmpeg ──▶ 30 s before + 5 min after each motion ──▶ one video a day, with chapters (home) ──ONVIF motion events──▶ ──▶ YouTube · OneDrive · WebDAV · rclone · disk (a page to watch them all) ``` ## Features - **Motion-triggered recording.** Keeps 30 seconds *before* the detection and 5 minutes *after*; motion near the end of the window extends it. description: Raspberry Pi infrared and RS-232 internet bridge, virtual modem and modern-web gateway for vintage computers and handhelds
readme_excerpt: # RetroModem **A Raspberry Pi internet bridge, virtual modem and modern-web gateway for vintage computers and handhelds.** > **First public release.** The installer has completed a clean-SD installation > and `retromodem-verify` reported zero errors. Raspberry Pi 3 Model B is the > supported Pi model for this release. Infrared RetroModem in its closed enclosure next to a Palm IIIc *The current infrared RetroModem prototype with a Palm IIIc.* RetroModem gives devices such as a Psion 5mx, Palm IIIc, Windows 98/XP PC and classic Macintosh a route to the internet without requiring another computer as a gateway. It supports direct PPP, a Hayes-compatible dial-up modem, public BBS connections, file transfer and a web interface designed for both modern and very old browsers. The preferred build uses a Ming Yuan MY018 infrared module on the Pi GPIO/UART. A Prolific USB-to-RS-232 adapter provides the main wired path, while a Mobile Action MA-620 remains available as a USB infrared fallback. ## Install Flash **Raspberry Pi OS Legacy Bookworm (32-bit) Lite** with Raspberry Pi Imager, enable SSH and boot the Pi. Then run this command in its SSH session: ```sh curl -fsSL | sh ``` The guided installer asks which connection hardware to configure. Do not download the automatically generated GitHub source archives as an installation package; the bootstrap command above is the supported installation method. See the complete installation guide before connecting or powering an MY018 module. ## What it can do - direct PPP over infrared or RS-232; - Hayes commands and dial-up internet through `ATDT5559000`; - a configurable phone book for public BBS systems; - ChatGPT through a small HTML interface or the local BBS number `5559999`; - Search and simplified modern web pages on legacy browsers

description: Cost-efficient coding-agent runtime: prefix-aware prompt-cache routing, poisoning-safe semantic cache, budgeted context compression, request batching/dedup, cascading model routing with DP-optimal policies, hard budget scheduling, span-level cost attribution, sandboxed tools, synthetic workload factory. NumPy core, CPU-only torch extra.
readme_excerpt: # frugent frugent 是一个 Python 3.11+ 工具包，用于在完全离线、可复现的合成编码工作负载上验证成本高效 agent 运行时机制。项目聚焦路由、缓存、压缩、批处理、预算、追踪和沙箱执行的工程行为，不评估任何真实大模型的质量。 默认测试不访问网络、不需要 API key、GPU、预训练权重或外部数据集。报告中的成本使用明确标注的 fictional rate card；合成任务包含 planted solution path 与已知最优成本，用来验证机制而非代表生产负载。 ## 机制范围 | 机制 | 可验证行为 | |---|---| | prefix / semantic cache | affinity routing、TTL、LRU/LFU、严格 exact retrieval | | context compression | sliding window、extractive scoring、knapsack、needle recall | | batching | single-flight、fan-out、deadline dispatch、micro-batch wait bound | | cascade / budget | quality floor、DP optimum、hard admission、degradation ladder | | tracing / sandbox | cost conservation、checksummed JSONL、allowlist、timeout/replay | | offline runtime | scripted/replay/local-loopback adapter、plan→act→observe | 这些机制验证“如何运行与计量”，不验证真实 LLM 回答质量。 ## 开发 ```bash uv venv .venv uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e ".[dev]" make build test format-check ``` 可选 CPU PyTorch demo： ```bash uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python --extra-index-url --index-strategy unsafe-best-match -e ".[dev,torch]" make test-all typecheck ``` 默认 NumPy 路径不加载 torch；`uv.lock` 固定开发解析结果。 ## 快速使用 ```bash frugent route frugent compress --token-budget 4096 frugent bench --seed 7 --tasks 24 frugent report --seed 7 --tasks 24 --format html --output report.html frugent demo --seed 7 --tasks 12 ``` 机制命令输出 canonical JSON；`run` / `demo` 同时给出实际 route/cache/batch/budget stage 计数，`report` 直接输出 Markdown/HTML。cost 是 fictional micro-cost，latency 是离散事件模拟值。 ## 示例 - prompt-cache routing：planted affinity 与 SVG。 - cascade optimum：runtime policy 与 DP optimum。 - compression recall：token budget degradation curve。 - mini cost audit：完整 HTML 成本报告。 四个示例均执行项目函数得到输出，不依赖预先写好的结果表。 ## 证据边界 - token savings、cache hit、cost、latency、recall 只来自 seeded synthetic workload。 - fictional rate

readme_excerpt: # wiki-style-article 題材を幅広く調べ、日本語版 Wikipedia の記事の型と作法で書いた記事を作る、AI のコーディング道具（Claude Code・Codex など）向けのスキルです。「/wiki 月ノ美兎」のように呼ぶと、調べた結果から、導入部・Infobox・目次・節・脚注・関連項目・カテゴリを備えた記事を、HTML 1 枚とウィキテキストで書き出します。 **非公式の道具です。** ウィキペディア（Wikipedia）およびウィキメディア財団とは関係がなく、公認・提携もありません。「Wikipedia」はウィキメディア財団の商標です。 ## できること - 題材の類型（人物・漫画・出来事・場所・製品・概念など 19 の基本型と 29 の細かい種類）を決め、類型ごとの節の並びと Infobox で書く - 観点ごとに調べものの担当（サブエージェント）を最大 8 人並べ、出典つきの事実を集める - 日本語版の作法（評価語を足さない、言葉を濁さない、常体、表記ガイドなど）に沿って書き、書き出す前にスクリプトで検査する - 信頼できる資料で確かめられなかった事実も落とさず、本家と同じ `[要出典]`・`[信頼性要検証]` の印を付けて載せる。印のある記事には、冒頭に警告の枠が付く - 本家がよく引くインターネットアーカイブ（web.archive.org）の保存版も取って確かめる - 出力は、本家の今の見た目に寄せた HTML 1 枚（外部の資源を読まない）と、本家のテンプレートの形のウィキテキスト 記事は日本語だけで書きます。 ## 要るもの - Python 3.11 以上。無ければ uv があれば足ります（uv が Python を取ってきます） - Web の検索とページの取得ができる道具 ## 入れ方 ### Claude Code ```bash claude plugin marketplace add YSRKEN/wiki-style-article claude plugin install wiki-style-article@wiki-style-article ``` 会話の中なら `/plugin marketplace add YSRKEN/wiki-style-article` と `/plugin install wiki-style-article@wiki-style-article` でも入れられます。更新は `claude plugin update wiki-style-article@wiki-style-article` です（自動では更新されません）。 ### Codex `plugins/wiki-style-article/skills/` の下の `wiki/`・`wiki-with-rumor/`・`wiki-both/` の 3 つのフォルダを、使うリポジトリの `.agents/skills/` にコピーします（`wiki-with-rumor` と `wiki-both` は隣の `wiki` のファイルを使うので、並べて置きます）。自分の全体で使うなら `~/.agents/skills/` に置きます（Codex の文書による）。呼ぶときは `$wiki`・`$wiki-with-rumor`・`$wiki-both`、または `/skills` です。 Codex には調べものの担当の定義を同梱していないので、設定の `[agents]` で既定のモデルを決めていなければ、担当は呼んだ会話と同じモデルで動きます。Codex の Web の検索は既定で索引から返す方式（`web_search = "cached"`）です。最新のページを取りたいときは、設定の `web_search` を `"live"` にします。 2026-11-02 に、Codex 0.160.1（Windows）で `$wiki しぐれうい` を試しました。 - 生成前の問いは、文で 1 問ずつ出ます。`codex exec` のような一回きりの実行では、問いを出したところで止まります。続きは `codex exec resume "4"` のように、同じ会話に答えを

readme_excerpt: # Ventilatory Efficiency & VE/VCO2 Slope Cardiorespiratory Skill ![License: MIT]( ![Python 3.10+]( ![Zero Dependencies]( ![OpenClaw Ready]( ![MCP Protocol]( A sovereign personal agent capability for computational CPET analysis, calculating the $\dot{V}_E / \dot{V}CO_2$ ventilatory equivalent slope, pulmonary dead space fraction, and V-slope anaerobic threshold. ## Architecture ```mermaid flowchart TD CPETData["CPET Timeseries: VE (L/min), VCO2 (L/min), VO2 (L/min)"] --> RegressionEngine["Linear Least-Squares Regression (VE vs VCO2)"] RegressionEngine --> SlopeMetrics["VE/VCO2 Slope, Intercept & R² Correlation"] CPETData --> VSlopeEngine["Beaver V-Slope Inflection Detection (Delta VCO2 / Delta VO2 > 1.0)"] VSlopeEngine --> Threshold["Ventilatory Anaerobic Threshold (VAT / VT1)"] SlopeMetrics & Threshold --> CREI["Cardiorespiratory Efficiency Index (0 - 100)"] CREI --> AgentPrescription["OpenClaw / Hermes Zone 2 & Threshold Pacing Directives"] ``` ## Quickstart ```python from client import VentilatoryEfficiencyClient client = VentilatoryEfficiencyClient() # Incremental exercise gas exchange series vco2 = [0.65, 0.95, 1.30, 1.70, 2.15, 2.60, 3.10] ve = [18.2, 25.5, 34.0, 44.5, 56.0, 68.5, 82.0] slope_res = client.calculate_ve_vco2_slope(ve, vco2) print("VE/VCO2 Slope:", slope_res["ve_vco2_slope"]) print("Efficiency Index:", slope_res["cardiorespiratory_efficiency_index"], "/ 100") print("Status:", slope_res["status"]) ``` ## MCP Server Integration Add to your `claude_desktop_config.json` or OpenClaw tool registry: ```json { "mcpServers": { "ventilatory-efficiency": { "command": "python", "args": ["/path/to/genpark-personal-agent-ventilatory-equivalent-ve-vco2-efficiency-skill/mcp_server.py"] } } } ``` ## License MIT License.

description: Maya TTS: streaming Indic + English text-to-speech (inference engine)
readme_excerpt: # Maya2 TTS Streaming multilingual text-to-speech for **11 Indic languages and English**, with 20 built-in voices and zero-shot voice cloning. This repository is the **inference engine**: a continuous-batching CUDA-graph engine, a Python API, an OpenAI-compatible HTTP server and a WebSocket streaming server. The weights are on Hugging Face at **maya-research/maya2-native**. **Samples · Model card · Engine docs · Text normaliser** > The Python package and model are called **Maya3**; `maya2-native` is the repository name. - **Languages:** as bn en gu hi kn ml mr or pa ta te. - **Streaming:** about 14 ms to first audio at B=1 on an H100. One H100 NVL serves **224 concurrent streams** at **323 s of audio per second**, with steady-state TTFA p99 **242 ms** and 0 playback stalls. - **Voices:** 20 named voices (`voice="Ahana"`), or clone a voice from 3-10 s of audio. - **Text normaliser (bundled):** numbers, currency, dates, URLs and ALL-CAPS names are spoken correctly in every language. ## Install You need Python 3.10-3.12, Linux and an NVIDIA GPU with a CUDA 12.8 driver (8 GB or more of GPU memory). ```bash git clone maya3 && cd maya3 python -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate pip install -e ".[server]" --extra-index-url ``` The pinned runtime is torch 2.8.0 (cu128, triton 3.4.0), transformers 5.6.2 and speechbrain 1.1.2. Weights, the Mimi codec and the ECAPA speaker encoder are downloaded from Hugging Face on first use. Set `HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1` to use only the local cache. ## Quickstart ### Python ```python from maya3 import Maya3TTS import soundfile as sf tts = Maya3TTS.from_pretrained("maya-research/maya2-native", max_seats=16) wav = tts.generate("नमस्ते, आपका ऑर्डर कल पहुँच जाएगा।", lang="hi", voice="Ahana") sf.write("out.wav", wav, 24000) # float32, 24 kHz mono for pcm

readme_excerpt: # Exolune **Real-scale planets. Seamless from orbit to the ground.** From the whole planet down to a forest clearing, in one continuous shot *One shot, no cut, no loading: from the whole globe down to a clearing in the forest.* --- **Exolune is a space game in the making, built on its own planet engine, and its source is public.** The planets are not maps or skyboxes: each one is a whole world at real scale, 6,378 km in radius like the Earth, rendered every frame from the orbit down to the pebble at your feet. **Seamless means no loading screen and no cut.** The terrain is recomputed on the GPU around the camera, so the same planet holds at every altitude. description: Official PyTorch implementation of "BlendGAN: Implicitly GAN Blending for Arbitrary Stylized Face Generation" (NeurIPS 2021)
readme_excerpt: # BlendGAN: Implicitly GAN Blending for Arbitrary Stylized Face Generation Official PyTorch implementation of the NeurIPS 2021 paper teaser Mingcong Liu, Qiang Li, Zekui Qin, Guoxin Zhang, Pengfei Wan, Wen Zheng Y-tech, Kuaishou Technology ### Project page | Paper Abstract: *Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) have made a dramatic leap in high-fidelity image synthesis and stylized face generation. Recently, a layer-swapping mechanism has been developed to improve the stylization performance. However, this method is incapable of fitting arbitrary styles in a single model and requires hundreds of style-consistent training images for each style. To address the above issues, we propose BlendGAN for arbitrary stylized face generation by leveraging a flexible blending strategy and a generic artistic dataset. Specifically, we first train a self-supervised style encoder on the generic artistic dataset to extract the representations of arbitrary styles. In addition, a weighted blending module (WBM) is proposed to blend face and style representations implicitly and control the arbitrary stylization effect. By doing so, BlendGAN can gracefully fit arbitrary styles in a unified model while avoiding case-by-case preparation of style-consistent training images. To this end, we also present a novel large-scale artistic face dataset AAHQ. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BlendGAN outperforms state-of-the-art methods in terms of visual quality and style diversity for both latent-guided and reference-guided stylized face synthesis.* ### Updates :heavy_check_mark: (2021-12-03) The AAHQ dataset has been released! :heavy_check_mark: (2021-11-22) add an interactive demo based on Jupyter notebook :heavy_check_mark: (2021-11-19) a web demo is integrated to Huggingface Spaces with Grad

readme_excerpt: # muscle-supermimic **Whole-body motion tracking for musculoskeletal humanoids with one differentiable world model:** SuperMimic driving MS-Human-700 (700 muscles) and MyoFullBody (354 muscles), on mjlab / MuJoCo-Warp. Three KIT training clips (turning left, walking forward, walking backward), each tracked by MS-Human-700 (left of the pair) and MyoFullBody (right), each with its own policy at iteration 10000; muscles are colored by activation, from light grey (0) to deep red (1). SuperMimic trains a tracking policy by backpropagating through rollouts of a learned world model of the body. readme_excerpt: # idea-review：给你的研究 idea 做一次文献调研和多模型评审 中文 | English 输入一句话的研究 idea，它会： 1. **拆检索词**：把 idea 拆成几条英文检索式，覆盖不同说法和相邻方向。 2. **检索**：在 Semantic Scholar、arXiv、OpenAlex 上搜，合并去重。 3. **初筛**：按标题和摘要判断先读哪些。这一步只决定"值不值得读全文"，不判断"有没有人做过"。 4. **下载全文**：把开放获取的 PDF 下载到本地（检索结果里没挂链接的，按标题去 arXiv 找预印本），抽出文字并按页标上 `[p.N]`。 5. **精读、评质量**：逐篇读全文，写"它实际做了什么"，核对摘要和正文是否一致，先分清论文类型（实证、综述、立场文章、数据集等），再按这一类的标准分成高、中、低三档。读到的全文太少或者全是低质量，就停在这一步（见证据不够时）。 6. **找空白**：根据精读笔记画出这个方向的版图，找出有论文证据支撑的空白。读到的文献少，空白也少写。 7. **挖新方向**：从空白里挖出几个和你的原始 idea 有实质区别的方向。 8. **写 proposal（模型 A）**：给你的原始 idea 和每个新方向各写一份 proposal。 9. **元评审（模型 B、C、D…）**：换成别家公司的模型，各开一个新对话，只给 proposal 和论文材料，写 meta review：撞车、死因、可行性、最便宜的证伪实验，不打分、不下结论。 10. **汇总**：整理几位评审的共识和分歧，列出你必须亲自核实的说法。 11. **出报告**：生成一个自包含的 HTML 报告，手机和电脑都能看。 拍板的是你。报告只负责把材料摆齐。 ## 为什么这么设计 - **读全文，不只读摘要。** 很多 agent 查文献时只读摘要，可有的论文摘要写的和正文实际做的并不一样，光看摘要可能就把一个方向跳过了。所以精读和评审都基于全文。摘要夸大或者和正文矛盾的地方会标出来；摘要的说法没错、只是没交代适用范围的（比如只在部分模型上测过），单独列出，不算矛盾。 - **写的和审的不是同一家。** 模型都有点讨好用户，给自己写的东西打分也偏高。配置里给每个模型标上 `family`，写 proposal 的和做评审的是同一家时，程序会提醒你。 - **评审不打分。** 模型判断"新不新、行不行"很不稳定，问法改几个字结论就可能变。所以只让它交出能核实的东西：哪篇论文、第几页、哪个实验。 - **文献质量只看证据。** "已发表 / 预印本"、引用数单独标出来；质量档位只看论文本身的实验和论证，而且按论文类型分别判断，综述、立场文章不会因为没做实验就被判成低质量。 - **证据不够就不往下编。** 只读到两三篇，或者读到的都是低质量论文时，硬让模型找空白、写 proposal，它也能写出一大堆，但多半站不住，还白花钱和时间。所以这时程序会停下来，告诉你怎么补文献。 ## Skill 版 不想配 API key、不想装命令行工具的，可以用 `skill/idea-review/` 里的 skill：装进 Claude Code、Codex 这类 code agent，直接跟它说"帮我看看这个 idea"就行。 和命令行版的区别： - 读论文、找空白、写 proposal 的是你正在用的 agent 自己，用的是它的订阅，不用另外配 API key。 - 检索、下载全文、检查格式、"证据不够就停"、调别家模型做元评审，由 skill 里的脚本完成，规则和命令行版一样。脚本只用 Python 标准库。 - 元评审调用本机装好的别家命令行工具（codex、gemini、claude 里去掉和 agent 同一家的），或者 OpenAI 兼容接口。一家都没有时用子代理代评，报告里会标明是同一家的模型。 - 运行目录里的文件格式和命令行版一样，报告样式也一样。 在 Claude Code 里安装： ```bash cp -r skill/idea-review ~/.claude/skills/ ``` 只想在某个项目里用，就复制到那个项目的 `.claude/skills/` 下。其他支持 Agent Skil

Click a thumbnail to select it — nothing is crammed into a combo box, so hundreds of entries stay fast. ### 2. 选中即在节点上看到线稿，无需反复开关面板 选完姿态，线稿图**直接渲染在节点上**（批量节点最多显示 4 张，带 `+N` 标记）， 确认姿态对不对不用再重新打开面板。 The selected line-art sketch renders **directly on the node** (up to 4 on batch nodes, with a `+N` badge), so you can verify the pose without reopening the panel. ### 3. 缩略图严格 3:4，三档宽度，面板可自由缩放 素材原图是 3:4，缩略图**严格按 3:4 渲染**，提供 **90 / 120 / 150 px** 三档宽度； 面板右下角可拖拽拉宽拉高，尺寸自动记忆，一次能看更多姿态。 Thumbnails keep the assets' native **3:4** aspect at three width presets (**90 / 120 / 150 px**).
